meta.title: Request a service or advice in one message | cod by nasser
meta.description: Tell me in one message what’s troubling your business, even if you don’t know which service fits. It reaches me on WhatsApp or by email, and I reply myself.

title: Tell me what’s giving you trouble.
say: One message is enough, and it commits you to nothing. I read every request myself, and reply the way you choose.

service.unsure: I’m not sure yet and need advice

details.label: Tell me about your business or idea
details.placeholder: For example: I run a clothing shop, and customers ask the same questions every day.
details.hint: Two or three lines are enough. No technical terms needed.
